profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Hidden Level
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
In my current role, I’ve had the opportunity to lead and contribute to a variety of projects that have significantly advanced our technology offerings and operational efficiency:

• Led the design and beta testing of our flagship app for Android, iOS, and Web using a diverse tech stack including AWS, Firebase, and Flutter, significantly reducing reliance on third-party apps and lowering operational costs.

• Enhanced our Airspace Monitoring Service (AMS) core product by enabling the integration of third-party sensor data feeds, boosting product offering and expanding our reach in the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) sector.

• Developed an alerting system with AWS SNS, SES, and Firebase for immediate notifications on drone activities, improving user engagement and safety measures.

• Developed a health monitoring system for various software components, alongside a Flask-based dashboard for real-time status updates, fostering proactive system maintenance and swift issue resolution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered a cross-platform application with Flutter, enabling remote control and management of Software Defined Radios (SDRs) through a Flask-based RESTful API, streamlining operations and user interaction.

• Advanced our signal processing capabilities by developing software for radio spectrum analysis and signal pattern identification using Python, C++ and GNU Radio.

•Took the lead in modernizing project structures, adopting current best practices that boosted both project maintainability and efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · C++ · Python · Flutter · REST APIs · Mobile Application Development · Software Defined Radio · Linux
